reviews.comment: Dr. Shaub is the most caring and knowledgeable professor I ever had in Mays. This class was super difficult, and it should not be treated like any other accounting class. Read the textbook and work multiple choice questions in textbook questions, and you should be fine. Writing assignments will boost your grade.

Dr. Shaub is the best professor at TAMU. Although his grade distribution may be lower for certain classes, you will learn so much taking Dr. Shaub. He cares for his students and wants you to learn the most you can so you can be the best professional after college. The question is do you want an easy A or do you want to learn?

Really great guy who actually wants you to do well in the class. His tests are hard, but if you study for them and pay attention in class, you can do well. He is more than happy to meet with you and help you improve if you are struggling. But it is a tough course with lots of material you need to learn.
reviews.ratingTags: Respected--Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Dr. Shaub is an amazing professor, but this course is challenging by nature. There are a lot of articles to read and many small assignments due along the way. There is only 1 exam, so make sure to study hard for it. Attendance is mandatory. If you're ever having problems, let him know - he's very understanding. Best professor I've ever had.
